sentences.text:
Counsel for Petitioner :- Dinesh Kumar Shukla
Counsel for Respondent :- G.A.
Hon'ble Mrs. Sangeeta Chandra,J.
Hon'ble Mrs. Jyotsna Sharma,J.
1.
Sri Dinesh Kumar Shukla, counsel for the petitioners has sent out of station slip.

Sri Rajiv Mishra,
Advocate, has filed his power on behalf of respondent no.4-Smt. Renu Devi.

2. This criminal misc. writ petition has been filed with the following prayer:
"(i) Issue a writ, order or direction in the nature of Certiorari by quashing the impugned first information report dated 20.09.2023 in the first information report bearing no. 0426 of 2023 under section 498A. 323, 504 and 546 I.P.C. registered at police station Asandra, District- Barambaki and directing the authorities not to Durgesh Kumar And Others vs State Of U.P. Thru. Secy. Home Deptt.

1 arrest/harass the petitioner on the basis of impugned first information report."
3.
Smt. Renu Devi is present in person along with her child.
She has expressed her unwillingness to undergo mediation.
4. This Court has perused the F.I.R. which shows a cognizable offence to be made out.

This court finds no good ground to put interference in the impugned F.I.R.
5.
Accordingly, the writ petition is dismissed.
